Remove from fryer and place in a Save-A-Day to remove excess oil
Plateware: Lined oval basket
Garnish: Powder sugar, 2oz Raspberry sauce

name: Ice Cream
steps: Put 2 (each) 2oz scoops of ice cream into a single service cup
Serve with a soup spoon
Plateware: Serve on a small plate with a Black napkin & a soup spoon

name: Avocado Ceviche (Bar & Grill)
steps: Salad: In a small mixing bowl, combine the Avocado mix with the Shrimp Ceviche
In a large salad bowl, place the spring mix, then the spinach on top
On top of the salad, spread out the ceviche mixture.
Spread out 10-15 Plantain chips on top of the salad
Place a 4-oz cup of mango vinaigrette off to the side
Plateware: Large Bowl
Expo/Server: 4oz Mango Vinaigrette Dressing

name: Caesar Salad Large
steps: In a mixing bowl, toss 2- 12/14oz logo cup of romaine lettuce with cheese, croutons, and Caesar dressing.
Combine well.
Place in pasta bowl.
Expo: Garlic bread
Plateware: Pasta bowl
Served w/ Garlic Bread & Chicken

name: Caesar Salad Small
steps: In a mixing bowl - toss a 12/14oz logo cup of romaine lettuce, with cheese, croutons, and Caesar dressing. Combine well.
Place on the correct plateware.
Plateware: App plate or small bowl

name: Calamari Caesar
steps: Salad: Lightly toss 2 12/14oz logo cups of romaine lettuce, cheese, and croutons with Caesar dressing.
Combine well
Place in a salad bowl.
Fry Person - Calamari: Place the 6-oz portion of calamari into the milk wash and drain the excess.
Transfer calamari and add cherry peppers to the flour and coat evenly and thoroughly.
Once calamari is covered, shake off excess.
Place in a 350°F fryer for approx. 3 minutes or until golden brown
Transfer to a save-a-day to drain excess oil.
Sprinkle with house spice
Expo: Garlic bread
Plateware: Pasta bowl

name: Chicken for Salad
steps: Grilled / Blackened: Baste 1 chicken breast with garlic spread for the flat top only
Lightly dust with requested seasoning
Place chicken breast on grill with buttered side down. After 4 minutes, flip the chicken and cook for an additional approx. 3 minutes to an internal temperature of 165°F.
Brush with garlic spread to moisten, then slice the chicken into 5 strips before plating.
Fried: Place 1 chicken breast in milk, wash and drain the excess.
Transfer to a separate container, chicken breader, and coat evenly, and shake off excess.
After breading, place in a 350°F fryer for approx. 4-5 minutes or until lightly golden brown in color and an internal temperature of 165°F.
Remove from fryer and transfer to a Save-A-Day to drain off excess oil.
Slice the chicken into 5 strips before plating.
Plateware: App plate

name: Clam Chowder Cup
steps: Using a 10-oz ladle, serve 8oz of heated clam chowder in a soup cup.
Place on a lined serving plate
Garnish: 1 pk Captains Wafers

name: Clam Chowder Bowl
steps: Using a 10-oz ladle, serve 12oz of heated clam chowder in a soup bowl.
Place the bowl on a lined plate.
Place the soup spoon on the side bowl.
Garnish: 2 pk Captains Wafers
Plateware: Soup cup, Lined dessert plate, Soup spoon

name: House Salad Large
steps: Place House Salad mix in a large pasta bowl.
Place cherry tomatoes and red onion strips on top of the salad mix
Top with shredded cheese and croutons
Garnish: 4oz dressing of choice
Plateware: Pasta bowl

name: House Salad Small
steps: Place salad mix on the appetizer plate.
Place cherry tomatoes and onion rings on top of the salad mix.
Top with shredded cheddar cheese and croutons.
Garnish: 2oz cup of dressing requested
Plateware: App plate

name: Mahi for Salad
steps: Grilled/Blackened: Baste Mahi with garlic spread and then lightly and evenly dust with Old Bay or Blackening Seasoning.
Place on a flat top. After 4 minutes, flip and cook for approximately 4 minutes.
When Mahi is finished cooking, brush with garlic spread to moisten before plating.
Broiled: Place Mahi on a broil pan and cover with water.
Baste with garlic spread and lightly and evenly dust with Old Bay.
Place in a 450-500°F oven for approximately 5 minutes.
When finished cooking, brush with garlic spread to moisten before plating.
Fried: Place Mahi into the milk wash and drain the excess.
Transfer to breading and shake off the excess, making sure to cover the Mahi thoroughly.
Transfer Mahi to a 350°F fryer for approx. 5 minutes or until golden brown and cooked thoroughly.
Transfer from fryer to Sav-A-Day to drain excess oil.
Plateware: App plate

name: Salmon for Salad
steps: Grilled / Blackened: Baste Salmon with garlic spread, then lightly and evenly dust with Old Bay or blackening seasoning.
Place on a flat top. Cook for 4 minutes, then flip and cook for approximately 3 minutes.
Brush with garlic butter
Place the Salmon on an app plate and serve.
Broiled: Place the Salmon on a broil pan, and add water to the pan to keep from burning.
Baste with garlic spread and lightly dust with Old Bay.
Place in a 450-500°F oven for approx. 5 minutes.
Brush with garlic spread to moisten and plating.
Place the Salmon on an app plate and serve.
Expo: Lemon wedge
Plateware: App plate

name: Shrimp Add-On SA for Salad Key West (St Augustine)
steps: Baste 2 skewers with garlic spread and dust evenly with Old Bay.
Place skewers on the flat top.
Flip skewers after approx. 2 minutes.
Baste shrimp with honey mustard
Continue cooking until the shrimp are thoroughly cooked and no longer translucent.
Place the skewers on the app plate.
Plateware: App Plate

name: Shrimp for Salad
steps: Grilled: Baste 2 skewers with garlic spread and dust evenly with the requested seasoning.
Place skewers on the flat top.
Flip skewers after approx. 2 minutes.
Continue cooking until shrimp are thoroughly cooked and no longer translucent.
Baste shrimp with garlic spread before plating.
Place skewers on the correct serving plate.
Fried if Requested: Bread 8 P&D Shrimp by dipping in milk wash and coating evenly, draining them, and coating them evenly in Italian breading.
Place breaded shrimp in a 350°F fryer and cook for approximately 4 minutes, or until golden brown. Shrimp will float when cooked.
Transfer to a Sav-A-Day to drain excess oil.
Transfer to the plaid boat
Plateware: App Plate

name: Tuna for Salad
steps: Grill/Blackened: Brush tuna with garlic butter and season as requested on both sides
Place on a flat top for 2 minutes on each side
When done, plate and give to the expo
Expo: lemon wedge
Plateware: App Plate

name: Filet Tip Add-On (Add $6.25)
steps: Top with Tips with steak seasoning
Cook on the flat top to the desired temperature.
Brush finished tips with 1oz of room temperature garlic spread.
Rare - a cool red center; pink otherwise 125–130°F
Medium Rare - a warm red center, otherwise pink 130–140°F
Medium - warm pink center, otherwise brown 140–150°F
Medium Well - mostly brown with a gray center, very little, if any, pink 150–160°F
Well Done - Brown throughout with no sign of pink >160°F
Expo: Steak knife
Plateware: App plate

name: Street Corn
steps: Lightly coat the corn with cilantro cream sauce
Cover the corn in Parmesan cheese
Sprinkle with Old Bay and serve
Garnish: Old bay, Parmesan cheese
Plateware: Lined oval basket
Finish off w/ Old Bay Seasoning

name: Zucchini, Summer Squash, & Carrots
steps: Use a 4-oz slotted spoodle/spoon to put on the plate for the side and in a monkey dish for a side order.
Plateware: Monkey dish, or Black plastic bowl when solo or with a basket entrée

name: Black Beans/Rice (Bar & Grill)
steps: Half Scoop rice in a monkey dish
Half Scoop beans on top of rice
Leave some of the rice showing
Plateware: Monkey dish or black plastic bowl

name: Broccoli
steps: Microwave for about 30 to 45 seconds per portion
Plateware: Monkey Dish or Black Plastic, or directly on the plate.

name: Chips (Bar & Grill)
steps: Place 1 bag of Chips into a 350°F fryer for about 4-6 minutes or until fries are cooked thoroughly and lightly golden brown in color.
Remove from fryer and transfer to pan under heat lamps.
Sprinkle with house spice.
Plateware: Lined Oval Basket

name: Coleslaw or Island Slaw
steps: Use an ivory scoop to put into monkey dish.
Plateware: Monkey dish or black plastic bowl

name: Corn (Bar & Grill)
steps: Fill the desired pan with water, butter, milk, and house spice
Bring corn up to temp in either boiling water or steamer
Once the contents of the corn stock reach the desired temperature (145°F), add corn and cover until ready to serve
Plateware: Monkey dish when solo, Directly on a plate or tray with the meal

name: Cream Corn w/ Bacon
steps: Use an ivory handle scoop for corn and put it on a dinner plate
Plateware: Monkey dish, or black plastic bowl, when solo or with a basket side

name: Fries
steps: Place 1 bag of French Fries into a 350°F fryer for about 4-6 minutes or until fries are cooked thoroughly and lightly golden brown in color.
Remove from fryer and transfer to pan under heat lamps.
Sprinkle with house spice.
Plateware: Lined oval basket for solo side

name: Grits
steps: Use an ivory scoop in a side dish or on a plate
Plateware: Monkey dish, or black plastic bowl for solo side

name: Mac & Cheese
steps: Use an ivory scoop to place on the plate or in a monkey dish
Sprinkle with toasted panko
Expo: Toasted panko
Plateware: Monkey dish, black plastic bowl when solo side or basket entrée

name: Mashed Potatoes
steps: Use an ivory scoop to put on the plate or into a monkey dish.
Make sure the scoop is not a perfectly round ball; use the back side of the scoop for patting down, and lift
Plateware: Monkey dish, or black plastic bowl, for solo side or basket entrée

name: Hushpuppies
steps: 6 each, no honey, on plate or in basket
Plateware: Plaid boat for solo side, or on a plate

name: Tacos Veggie
steps: Baste patty with olive oil (not pan spray), then season evenly with blackening seasoning
Cook the patty on a flat top, when cooked
Cut the patty into 3 even slices
Grill 3 flour tortillas,
Roll the sides of the tortillas up in the classic taco form on the required plate.
Add cabbage, cheese, then black bean strips in that order
Add sauces Baja and Salsa Verde, Red Onion & cilantro
Expo: 2 Lime wedges, Baja sauce, Salsa Verde, Cilantro, Red onion — See Expo Chart
Plateware: Taco Plate

name: Tacos Boom-Boom Shrimp
steps: Bread shrimp pieces pre-wash and then Italian Breading and toss in a 350°F fryer for about 3 minutes or until light golden brown in color and cooked thoroughly
Once the shrimp is cooked, transfer to a Sav-A-Day to drain off excess oil
Toss them in boom-boom sauce
Place the Flour Tortillas on the flat top grill for 5 to 8 seconds. Remove Immediately.
Place shells in the Taco plate slots
Add cabbage first, and the Cabbage should fill the taco shell about halfway
Place boom-boom shrimp on top, finish with cilantro
Expo: Cilantro, 2 Lime wedges — See Expo Chart, Side
Plateware: Taco Plate

name: Tacos Avocado
steps: Cut the avocado halves into 3 slices before breading
Coat with flour, milk wash, panko
Use 6 slices per order of tacos (2 in each taco)
Fry until golden brown
Place the Flour Tortillas on the flat top grill for 5 to 8 seconds. Remove Immediately.
Add 1/3 of the cheddar cheese to each taco
Add 1/3 of the cabbage to the top of each taco. The Cabbage should fill the taco shell about halfway
Add: Avocado on top of cabbage
Topped with the shredded carrots on each taco
Expo: 2 Lime wedges, Cilantro cream, Salsa verde, Carrots, Side
Plateware: Taco Plate

name: Bowl Steak
steps: Generously top the steak tips with steak seasoning on the grill
Cook to the desired temperature
Take a large bowl
Place the 2 scoops of Coco rice in the bottom
Place in quarters of the bowl on top of the rice - Cabbage, Pico, Wontons, and Avocado mix
Place the Protein on top in the middle
Expo: Lime Wedge, Soy-gave on protein, Cilantro Cream is drizzled in a zigzag motion across the top of the bowl, cilantro — NO SIDES
Plateware: Pasta bowl

name: Bowl Shrimp
steps: Brush Shrimp skewers with garlic butter and season (Old Bay or Blacken).
Place on a flat top for 2-3 minutes on each side
In a large Pasta bowl
Place the 2 scoops of Coconut rice in the bottom
Place in quarters of the bowl on top of the rice, add wontons, carrots, seaweed salad, & avocado salsa
Place the Protein on top in the middle
Expo: Lemon Wedge, Soy-gave on protein, Cilantro Cream is drizzled in a zigzag motion across the top of the bowl & protein, and topped with green onions. No sides
Plateware: Pasta bowl

name: Bowl Grouper
steps: Brush Grouper with garlic butter and season (Old Bay or Blacken).
Place on a flat top for 3-4 minutes on each side
In a large Pasta bowl
Place the 2 scoops of Coconut rice in the bottom
Add a scoop of Avocado salsa
Place in quarters of the bowl on top of the rice, carrots, & avocado
Place the Protein on top in the middle
Expo: Lemon Wedge, Soy-gave on protein, Cilantro Cream is drizzled in a zigzag motion across the top of the bowl & protein, topped with green onions. No Sides
Plateware: Pasta bowl

name: Bowl Chicken
steps: Cook chicken tenders as requested (grilled, blackened, or fried)
Take a large Pasta bowl, give it to Expo
Expo: place 2 scoops of Coconut rice in the bottom
Place in 1/4 of the bowl on top of rice - Cabbage, Wonton Strips, Pico & Avocado mix
Place the Protein on top in the middle
Expo: Lime Wedge, Soy-gave on protein, Cilantro Cream is drizzled in a zigzag motion across the top of the bowl, and topped with green onions. No Sides
Plateware: Pasta bowl

name: Bowl Ahi Tuna
steps: Brush the Tuna steaks with garlic butter and season both sides
Place on a flat top for 1.5-2 minutes on each side
In a large Pasta bowl
Place the 2 scoops of Coconut rice in the bottom
Place in quarters of the bowl on top of the rice, wontons, carrots, seaweed salad, & avocado mix
Place the Protein on top in the middle
Expo: Lime Wedge, Soy-gave on protein, Cilantro Cream is drizzled in a zigzag motion across the top of the bowl & protein, and topped with green onions. No Sides
Plateware: Pasta bowl

name: Tacos Braised Beef
steps: Grill 1 portion of short rib on a flat top with sauce, move the meat around with a spatula, and heat through
Place the Flour Tortillas on the flat top grill for 5 to 8 seconds. Remove Immediately.
Place 3 grilled tortillas in a taco plate,
Place enough cabbage to fill the shell halfway
Place 1/3 portion of short rib on cabbage in each shell
Top with red onion and cilantro
Expo: Baja sauce, Red onion, Cilantro, 2 Lime wedges, Side — See Expo Chart
Plateware: Taco Plate

name: Tacos Chicken
steps: Bread 3 chicken fingers using milk wash, then chicken breader.
Fry in a 350°F fryer for 3 minutes
Transfer chicken fingers to a Sav-a-Day to drain excess oil
Place the Flour Tortillas on the flat top grill for 5 to 8 seconds. Remove Immediately.
Roll the sides of the tortillas up in the classic taco form on the required plate.
Add 1/3 of the cheddar cheese to each taco
Add: 1/3 of the cabbage to the top of each taco.
Cabbage should fill the taco shell about halfway
Add protein on top of cabbage
Drizzle each taco with Baja sauce and salsa Verde
Top with diced red onion
Finish with cilantro
Expo: 2 Lime wedges, Baja sauce, Salsa verde, Cilantro, Red onion — See Expo Chart
Plateware: Taco Plate

name: Tacos Grouper Fried
steps: Cut the grouper sandwich into 3 even pieces and bread in milk wash, then Italian breader.
Fry in a 350°F fryer for 3 to 5 minutes until done.
Transfer the grouper to a Sav-a-Day to drain excess oil.
Place the Flour Tortillas on the flat top grill for 5 to 8 seconds. Remove Immediately.
Roll the sides of the tortillas up in the classic taco form on the required plate.
Add 1/3 of the cheddar cheese to each taco
Add: 1/3 of the cabbage to the top of each taco.
Cabbage should fill shells about halfway
Add protein on top of cabbage
Drizzle each taco with Baja sauce and salsa Verde
Top with diced red onion
Finish with cilantro
Expo: 2 Lime wedges, Baja sauce, Salsa verde, Cilantro, Red onion — See Expo Chart
Plateware: Taco Plate

name: Tacos Grouper Gr/Blk
steps: Cut the grouper vertically into 3 even strips
Lightly brush the grouper with garlic spread and lightly season with the Requested Seasoning.
Cooking 3 to 4 minutes on both sides
Place the 3 Flour Tortillas on the flat top grill for 5 to 8 seconds. Remove Immediately.
Roll the sides of the tortillas up in the classic taco form on the required plate.
Add 1/3 of the cheddar cheese to each taco
Add: 1/3 of the cabbage to the top of each taco
Cabbage should fill shells about halfway
Add protein on top of cabbage
Drizzle each taco with Baja sauce and salsa Verde
Top with diced red onion, finish with cilantro
Expo: 2 Lime wedges, Baja sauce, Salsa verde, Cilantro, Red onion — See Expo Chart
Plateware: Taco Plate

name: Tacos Mahi
steps: Baste Mahi with garlic spread
Evenly dust with blackening spice.
Place on flat top for approx. 3 minutes per side.
Place the Flour Tortillas on the flat top grill for 5 to 8 seconds. Remove Immediately.
Roll the sides of the tortillas up in the classic taco form on the required plate.
Add 1/3 of the cheese to the bottom of each taco.
Add 1/3 of the cabbage to each taco on top of the cheese
Cabbage should fill shells about halfway
Add 1 piece of mahi on top
Add 1/3 of the mango salsa on top of the mahi in each taco
Drizzle each taco with cilantro cream sauce.
Expo: 2 Lime wedges, Cilantro cream sauce — See Expo Chart
Plateware: Taco plate

name: Tacos Portabella
steps: Place the portabella with the top on the flat top
Baste with balsamic, letting some sit in the portabella cap like a bowl
Cook for 3 minutes and then flip
Cook for another 2 minutes, then cut into 3 equal pieces
Grill 3 flour tortillas,
Line the taco plate with the taco setup and place tortillas at the ends of the setup
Add cabbage, cheese, and portabella strips in that order
Add sauces Baja and Salsa Verde, Red Onion & cilantro
Expo: 2 Lime wedges, Baja sauce, Salsa Verde, Cilantro, Red onion — See Expo Chart
Plateware: Taco Plate

name: Tacos Short Rib (Dockside Clwtr)
steps: Note: Stores that have the shrimp BBQ sauce, please begin using a 50/50 mix of the juice and the shrimp sauce BBQ on the grill with the shredded short rib.
Grill 1 portion of short rib dry on a flat top
As it cooks, shred it up with a spatula on the grill and finish with some of the juice
On 3 grilled tortillas, place half and half pickled cabbage and dry cabbage
Place 1/3 portion of short rib on cabbage in each shell
Drizzle with Baja sauce and top with green onions
Expo: Baja sauce, Red onion, Cilantro, 2 Lime wedges, Side
Plateware: Taco Plate

name: Tacos Steak
steps: Cook the steak tip to a medium temperature, seasoned as requested
Place the Flour Tortillas on the flat top grill for 5 to 8 seconds. Remove Immediately.
Roll the sides of the tortillas up in the classic taco form on the required plate.
Add 1/3 of the cheddar cheese to each taco
Add 1/3 of the Siracha Cabbage to the top of each taco. Cabbage should fill the taco shell about halfway
Add protein on top of cabbage
Top with diced red onion
Expo: 2 Lime wedges, Cilantro, 1 side — See Expo Chart
Plateware: Taco Plate

name: NY Strip plus
steps: Generously top with steak seasoning
Cook on a char grill to the desired temperature.
Brush finished steak with 1oz of room temperature garlic spread.
Place on correct plateware.
Rare - a cool red center; pink otherwise 125–130°F
Medium Rare - a warm red center, otherwise pink 130–140°F
Medium - warm pink center, otherwise brown 140–150°F
Medium Well - mostly brown with a gray center, very little, if any, pink 150–160°F
Well Done - Brown throughout with no sign of pink >160°F
Expo: Steak knife
Plateware: App plate

name: Chicken Ranchero
steps: If using a flat top: Brush 2 chicken breasts with garlic butter and lightly season.
If using a char grill: just season the 2 chicken breasts
Cook for 2 minutes, then rotate 45° degrees angle
Cook for another 2 minutes and flip
Cook for another 2 minutes
Place the avocado salsa on the chicken and the cheese on top of the salsa.
Finish with warm/hot ranchero sauce.
Expo: Cilantro, sides requested
Plateware: Large Plate, Steak knife

name: Chicken Strips
steps: Fried: Place 9 chicken strips into the milk wash and drain the excess.
Transfer chicken to the breading and shake off excess.
Place breaded chicken into a 350°F fryer for approximately 5 minutes or until chicken begins to float and is golden brown to an internal temperature of 165°F.
Transfer to a sav-a-day to drain excess oil.
Toss in desired sauce if applicable.
Grilled: Flat Top - Baste 9 chicken tenders with garlic spread & requested seasonings
Char-Grill - Just Lightly season w/ Requested Seasoning
Place chicken strips on the grill with the buttered side down for 4 minutes and then flip for 3 more minutes or until the chicken internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Expo: Requested Sides, Dipping sauce, if requested
Plateware: Lined round basket

name: Loaded Chicken
steps: Grill/Flat top: Brush 2 chicken breasts with garlic butter (if using a flat top)
Just Season 2 chicken breasts and put on the char grill (no butter if using the char grill)
Cook for 2 minutes, then rotate 45°
Cook for another 2 minutes and flip
Cook for another 2 minutes
Move chicken to the flat top, put sauce, bacon, onion, and shredded cheese
Cover to melt cheese, put on a dinner plate, and sell to the expo when called for
Expo: Requested 2 sides, Steak Knife
Plateware: Large Plate, Steak knife

name: New York Strip
steps: Generously top with steak seasoning
Do not use pan spray on steak
Cook on a char grill to the desired temperature.
Brush finished steak with 1oz of warm garlic spread.
Rare - a cool red center; pink otherwise 125–130°F
Medium Rare - a warm red center, otherwise pink 130–140°F
Medium - warm pink center, otherwise brown 140–150°F
Medium Well - mostly brown with a gray center, very little, if any, pink 150–160°F
Well Done - Brown throughout with no sign of pink >160°F
Expo: Brush of Garlic butter, Requested sides
Plateware: Dinner plate, Steak knife

name: Ribs
steps: Unwrap the ribs and glaze with BBQ sauce
Cook in a 450-500°F oven on a silver pan for 8 to 15 minutes (depending on oven temp.) until heated through.
Once done, place on a lined 1/4 tray
**Add-on Nashville tender app, place next to ribs in combo
**Add-on 8 fried shrimp, place next to ribs if combo
Plateware: 1/4 lined Alum Tray, Steak knife

name: Ribs 1/2 plus
steps: Unwrap the rib and cut it in half
Glaze with BBQ sauce
Cook in a 450-500°F oven on a silver pan for 8 to 15 minutes (depending on oven) until heated through.
Once Ribs are done, place on a lined 1/4 tray
Plateware: Lined 1/4 tray
Garnish: 2oz BBQ sauce, Steak knife

name: Short Rib
steps: Shake portion(s) of short rib around in the mixed sauce, making sure it is fully covered
Place in the microwave for 1 to 3 minutes, depending on the strength of the microwave
Make sure the meat is 150°F in the center
Place on top of 2 scoops of grits and pour the remaining sauce onto the meat
Alternate heating method: Since this is an expo-only preparation, you would have the option to just hold this ready in the sauce in the steam table
From cold, it takes about 30 minutes to heat through in hot sauce, and they hold fine for about 5 to 6 hours
Expo: Green onion
Plateware: Dinner plate, napkin, rare bit

name: Southern Most Chicken
steps: Brush 2 chicken breasts with garlic butter if using a flat top
Season 2 chicken breasts and put them on a char grill or a flat top
Place chicken breasts on a chargrill with seasoned side down. After 4 minutes, flip and cook an additional 3 minutes. Cook until chicken is cooked throughout, to an internal temperature of 165°F.
Baste with honey mustard.
Top with drained mango salsa.
Expo: Requested sides
Plateware: Dinner plate, steak knife

name: Rib Eye Steak Cajun
steps: Generously top the Ribeye with steak seasoning
Place on the Char Grill for 2 minutes, then rotate 45° degrees
Cook for 2 minutes; this will create a diamond design
Flip and cook to the desired temperature.
Brush the diamond design side of the finished steak with warm Cajun Butter.
Rare - a cool red center; pink otherwise 125–130°F
Medium Rare - a warm red center, otherwise pink 130–140°F
Medium - warm pink center, otherwise brown 140–150°F
Medium Well - mostly brown with a gray center, very little, if any, pink 150–160°F
Well Done - Brown throughout with no sign of pink >160°F
Expo: Steak knife, and 2 sides
Plateware: Dinner plate, steak knife

name: Crab and Shrimp Boil
steps: Sauté: Place steam shrimp portion, and crab portion in the boiling Old Bay water for 2-3 minutes
Pour the ladle of Cajun/Garlic sauce into the skillet with shrimp, corn, and sausage
Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally
Add crab & shrimp to the skillet
Cook for another 3 to 4 minutes. If not using premade sauce, add cream and cook for another 3 to 4 minutes
Pour contents of skillet into a large plastic bag on a lined large beer tray
If using cream separately, it is 2 oz of cream with either 2 yellow scoops of Cajun butter or 1 8-oz ladle of scampi sauce
Expo: Put the side on the tray, Serve with 2 lemon wedges
Plateware: Lined Blue Oyster plate

name: Crab Boil 1.5
steps: Sauté: Place crab portion in boiling Old Bay water for 2-3 minutes
Pour the ladle of Cajun/Garlic sauce into the skillet with corn and sausage
Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally
Add crab to the skillet
Cook for another 3 to 4 minutes. If not using premade sauce, add cream and cook for another 3 to 4 minutes
Pour contents of skillet into a large plastic bag on a lined large beer tray
If using cream separately it's a 2-oz cup of cream with either 2 yellow scoops of Cajun butter or 1 8-oz ladle of scampi sauce
Expo: Put the side on the tray, Serve with 2 lemon wedges
Plateware: Lined Blue Oyster plate

name: Crab Boil 3/4
steps: Note: If using cream, separate it is a 2-oz cup of cream with either 2 yellow scoops of Cajun butter or 1 8-oz ladle of Scampi sauce
Sauté: Place crab portion in boiling Old Bay water for 2-3 minutes
Put 1-10-oz ladle of Cajun or Garlic sauce in a skillet with corn and sausage
Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally
Add the heated, drained crab to the skillet
Cook for another 3 to 4 minutes. If not using premade sauce, add cream and cook for another 3 to 4 minutes
Pour contents of skillet into a large plastic bag on a lined large blue tray
Hand off to the expo to be completed
Expo: Put the side on the tray, Serve with 2 lemon wedges
Plateware: Lined Blue Oyster tray

name: Seafood Feast
steps: Sauté: Place crab portions in boiling Old Bay water for 2-3 minutes
Pour 2-10-oz ladles of Cajun/Garlic sauce in a skillet with shrimp, corn, and sausage
Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally
Add crab to the skillet
Cook for another 3 to 4 minutes. If not using premade sauce, add cream and cook for another 3 to 4 minutes
Pour contents of skillet into a large plastic bag on a large beer tray and sell to expo
If using cream, separately it is a 2 oz cup of cream with either 2 yellow scoops of Cajun butter or 1-8oz ladle of scampi sauce
Expo: Put the side on the tray, Serve with 2 lemon wedges
Plateware: Lined Oyster tray

name: Shrimp Boil
steps: Sauté: Pour 1-10oz ladle of Cajun/Garlic sauce in the skillet to get hot
Add shrimp, corn, and sausage
Cook for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring occasionally
If using cream, separate it is a 2-oz cup of cream with either 2 yellow scoops of Cajun butter or 1 8-oz ladle of scampi sauce
If not using premade sauce, add cream and cook for another 3 to 4 minutes
Pour contents of skillet into a large plastic bag on a lined large beer tray and sell to expo when called for
Expo: Put the side on the tray, 2 lemon wedges
Plateware: Lined Oyster plate

name: Bairdi 1.5
steps: Steamed: Place crab portions into a boiling pot or steamer.
Cook for approximately 5 minutes.
Drain before plating onto a 1/4 lined tray
Grilled: Place drained boiled crab on a large sizzler pan.
Coat generously with garlic spread and Old Bay,
Place in a salamander or 450°F oven for 2 to 3 minutes or until seasoning is golden brown.
Place the crab on the lined 1/4 tray
Expo: Lemon wedge, 4oz of butter
Plateware: Lined 1/4 Aluminum sheet tray

name: Bairdi 3/4
steps: Steamed: Place crab portions into a boiling pot or steamer.
Cook for approximately 5 minutes.
Drain before plating onto a lined 1/4 tray
Grilled/Fire Roasted: Place drained boiled crab on a large sizzler pan
Coat generously with garlic spread and Old Bay
Place in a salamander or a 450°F oven for 2 to 3 minutes or until the seasoning is golden brown
Place on a lined 1/4 tray
Garnish: Lemon wedge, 2oz of butter
Plateware: Lined 1/4 Aluminum sheet tray

name: Calamari plus
steps: Place a 6-oz portion of calamari into the milk wash and drain excess.
Transfer calamari and cherry peppers to the flour and coat evenly and thoroughly.
Once calamari is covered, shake off excess.
Place in a 350°F fryer for approx. 3 minutes or until golden brown
Transfer to a Sav-a-Day to drain excess oil.
Sprinkle with house spice
Expo: Lemon wedge, 2oz lemon aioli
Plateware: Plaid food tray

name: Baked Oyster plus
steps: Place 6 prepped baked oysters on a pan, drizzle with garlic butter, then sprinkle with Old Bay.
Place in a 450°F oven for approx. 6 to 8 minutes or until oysters are cooked thoroughly and the tops are golden brown in color.
Place oysters in the food tray.
Garnish: Lemon wedge
Plateware: Plaid food tray, Cocktail fork

name: Chicken Strips plus
steps: Place 7 chicken strips into the milk wash and drain the excess.
Transfer chicken to the breading and shake off excess.
Place breaded chicken into a 350°F fryer for approximately 5 minutes, or until chicken begins to float and is golden brown to an internal temperature of 165°F.
Transfer to a Save-a-Day to drain excess oil.
Toss in desired sauce if applicable.
Plateware: Plaid food tray

name: Coconut Shrimp plus
steps: Place pre-breaded shrimp into a 325°F fryer for approximately 4-5 minutes or until golden brown.
Transfer to a Sav-a-Day to drain excess oil.
Expo: Lemon wedge, 2 oz Pepper jam
Plateware: Plaid food tray

name: Cod plus
steps: Dip 1 cod filet into milk wash, then flour, milk wash, then panko
Drop in a 350°F fryer for 5 minutes or until golden brown
Transfer to a Sav-a-day to drain excess grease
Spray malt vinegar twice on each side of the fish and sprinkle with kosher salt
Expo: Lemon wedge
Plateware: Plaid food tray

name: Crab Cake plus
steps: Fried: Portion 1 crab cake using the ivory handled scoop.
Place the crab cake directly into the flour and lightly dust.
Do not over-handle crab cake, it should not look like a perfect circle or ball
Transfer to 350°F fryer. Cook for about 2 minutes or until cakes have a rich golden brown color
Transfer to a Save A Day to drain off excess oil
Grilled: Portion 1 crab cake using ivory handled scoop
Do not over-handle crab cake; it should not look like a perfect circle or ball
Baste with garlic spread and Old Bay onto the crab cake, and place on a flat top.
Now, baste and season the top side of the crab cake while on the flat top.
Grill 1 side for 2 minutes, then turn over and grill the other side for 2 minutes
Brush with garlic spread to moisten before plating
Expo: Lemon, Pepper jam
Plateware: Plaid food tray

name: Fried Shrimp plus
steps: Bread 8 P&D shrimp by dipping in milk wash, draining, and coating in Italian breading. Shake off excess.
Place breaded shrimp in a 350°F fryer and cook for approximately 4 minutes or until golden brown. Shrimp will float when cooked.
Transfer to a Sav-a-Day to drain excess oil.
Expo: Lemon wedge
Plateware: Plaid food tray

name: Garlic Clams plus
steps: Place clams in the crab pot
Simmer 6oz ladle of scampi sauce while clams are heating up
Take clams out of the crab pot and mesh bag, then place in scampi sauce and cook for another minute or 2
Place the opened clams in a bowl, making sure that no shells are empty. (There must be a clam in each shell)
Pour scampi sauce over clams
Expo: Lemon wedge
Plateware: Soup bowl

name: Grilled Shrimp plus
steps: Baste skewers with garlic spread and dust evenly with Old Bay.
Place skewers on the flat top.
Flip skewers after approx. 2 minutes.
Continue cooking until shrimp are thoroughly cooked and no longer translucent.
Baste shrimp with garlic spread before plating.
Place skewers on the correct plateware.
Expo: Lemon wedge
Plateware: Lined 1/4 tray with crab or lobster

name: Grouper plus
steps: Fried: Place the grouper into the milk wash and drain the excess.
Transfer to breading and shake off the excess, making sure to cover the Grouper thoroughly.
Transfer Grouper to a 350°F fryer for approx. 4 minutes or until golden brown and cooked thoroughly.
Transfer to a Sav-a-Day to drain excess oil.
Place Grouper on 1# Plaid Food Tray and serve.
Grilled/Blackened: Baste grouper with garlic spread, then lightly and evenly dust with the Requested Seasoning.
Place on a flat top. Cook for 4 minutes, flip, and cook for approximately 3 minutes.
Brush with garlic butter
Place grouper in a plaid food tray and serve.
Broiled: Place Grouper on a broil pan, add water to the pan to keep from burning.
Baste with garlic spread and lightly dust with Old Bay or Blackening seasoning.
Place in oven for approx. 5 minutes.
Brush with garlic spread to moisten and plating.
Place Grouper on plaid food tray and serve.
Expo: Lemon wedge
Plateware: Plaid food tray

name: Jonah Claws
smallware: Dinner knife, Mallet
steps: Serve: 1# for appetizer and 2# for dinner
Cold: Crab is fully cooked and will be ideally served cold
Arrange neatly on the correct plateware
Hot: Place crab portions into a pot of water or a steamer.
Cook for approximately 3-4 minutes.
Drain before plating
Arrange neatly on the correct plateware.
Server Note: Claws are scored and can be easily opened by inserting a butter knife parallel with the score and twisting the shell off.
Expo: 2 lemons, 4oz cup Stone Mustard Sauce
Plateware: Lined 1/4 Tray

name: Lobster Tail (8 & 16oz)
steps: Cutting the Tail: Cut the shell from front to rear, being careful that you do not cut too deeply.
Pop open the bottom segment closest to the tail.
Pull meat out of the shell, still leaving the tail attached. Neatly place the lobster meat on top of the shell.
Make a 1/2'' incision down the center of the lobster tail.
Fan the lobster's tail fins out
Cooking: Place the lobster tail on a broil pan and fill with water to above where the tail fin stops
Baste the top with garlic spread
Place in a 450-500°F oven for approximately 6 minutes
Remove from the oven and re-baste with garlic spread, lightly dust with Old Bay
With a knife, make a (2) 1/2 inch incision running lengthwise with the tail across the meat to let the heat get in and speed up the cooking process.
Return to oven for approximately 5 minutes until lobster tail is cooked
When finished cooking, brush with garlic spread to moisten before plating onto the correct plateware.
Expo: Lemon wedge, 4oz drawn butter, Steak Knife
Plateware: Lined 1/4 Aluminum sheet tray/dinner plate

name: Mahi plus
steps: Grilled/Blackened: Baste Mahi with garlic spread and then lightly and evenly dust with the requested seasoning.
Place on a flat top. After 4 minutes, flip and cook for approximately 4 minutes.
When Mahi is finished cooking, brush with garlic spread to moisten before plating.
Broiled: Place Mahi on a broil pan and cover with water.
Baste with garlic spread and lightly and evenly dust with Old Bay.
Place in a 450°F oven for approx. 5 minutes.
When finished cooking, brush with garlic spread to moisten before plating.
Fried: Place Mahi into the milk wash and drain the excess.
Transfer to the breading and shake off the excess, making sure to cover the Mahi thoroughly.
Transfer Mahi to a 350°F fryer for approx. 5 minutes or until golden brown and cooked thoroughly.
Transfer from fryer to Sav-A-Day to drain excess oil.
Expo: Lemon
Plateware: Plaid food tray

name: Tuna
steps: Baste the Tuna with garlic spread
Season as requested
Place on a flat top
Cook 2 minutes, baste and flip
Cook another 1.5-2 minutes
Brush the Tuna with garlic spread to moisten before plating
Place on the correct plateware
Expo: lemon wedge
Plateware: App Plate

name: Steam Shrimp plus
steps: Hot: Place the mesh bag portion of the uncooked shrimp into the boiling Old Bay water

Let it boil for 3 minutes or until the shrimp have curled, but the shell has not been warped. A warped shell means that they are overcooked. The shell color should be bright orange, and the meat should be white in color.
Remove cooked shrimp from the mesh bag and arrange evenly on a plate.
Sprinkle shrimp with Old Bay seasoning
Expo: 2oz drawn butter
Plateware: On a lined aluminum tray with crab or lobster
Cold: Place the mesh bag portion of the uncooked shrimp into the boiling Old Bay water

Let it boil for 3 minutes or until the shrimp have curled, but the shell has not warped. A warped shell means that the shrimp are overcooked. The shell color should be bright orange, and the meat should be white in color.
Immediately remove shrimp from boiling water and place in a bath of ice water. Let the shrimp stand in ice water until completely chilled.
Remove cooked shrimp from the mesh bag and arrange evenly on a plate.
Sprinkle shrimp with Old Bay seasoning
Expo: Lemon wedge, 2oz melted butter
Plateware: On the lined aluminum tray with crab or lobster

name: Seabass Trimmings
smallware: scale, perforated pan, portion day bags, red mesh bags
steps: Sorting: separate into use for ceviche vs. use for dinner portion
Thaw under refrigeration
Drain completely once thawed
Add larger chunks to one side of sheet pan and smaller pieces to the other side
Place larger chunks in 8oz portion in plastic day bag
Small chunks will be used for ceviche
Cook off all small pieces
Portion into 8oz, or 1lb. bags for next batch(s)
Bag small pieces for cooking off
Portioning 8oz bags for dinner
notes: Source doc was marked "More to Come" and one step trails off mid-sentence ("Cook off all small pieces and ...") — this recipe appears to be a work in progress on the source side. Yield was also left blank in the original.

name: Benedict Country
steps: Place the ham steak on the flat top to heat both sides, and cut it in half
Butter the inside of the biscuit and place it on the flat top to toast.
Place 2 eggs in the poaching pan
Plate the toasted biscuit open-faced on a dinner plate
Add 1/2 of the ham steak to the top of each half of the biscuit
Add a poached egg atop each piece of ham
Finish adding Sausage gravy on top of each poached egg
Expo: requested sides
Plateware: Dinner Plate

name: Calamari
steps: Place Calamari into milk wash, drain excess, then into flour.
Place the Banana peppers into the flour to coat.
Once calamari is covered, shake off excess.
Place in 350°F fryer for approx. 4 to 5 minutes or until golden brown
Transfer to a save-a-day to drain the excess oil.
Sprinkle with house spice.
Expo: Lemon wedge, 2oz Red Sauce
Plateware: Lined Oval basket

name: Brussels Sprouts (Appetizer)
steps: Flash fry 1 portion of Brussels for 45 seconds
Transfer to Sav A Day, and allow excess oil to drain
Place Brussels in a mixing bowl
Ladle sauce over Brussels and toss together
Pour from the bowl into a rarebit
Top with Sesame seeds
Expo: Sesame seeds
Plateware: Pasta Bowl
